description: S16: check, checkmate, stalemate and attack maps on the real board (rules/boards/standard-9x9.json, rules/pieces/) under the draft 2-player ruleset. Every position runs at each king.range option. Expected results come from plain geometry worked out independently of the engine (docs/RULES.md). The Coast is treated as open.
